setting.string: Default sale price of BOSS services
setting.help: Expected cost of the line + this percentage, as a rule of the default pricelist. A customer's agreed price and a price typed on the line come first. 0 = off.

A weekly ocean or air freight rate typed from a quotation is approved at once by the person who enters it: an urgent quotation never waits for an approver in another time zone (Ángel, 27/10/2026). Off: it waits for a tariff approver.
A tariff needs the supplier's document attached to be sent for approval (every price traceable to it). Ángel asked Cristina whether it must be compulsory: switch it off to approve without the file.
What to do when a supplier price is in another currency than the quotation.
Odoo tax of each VAT case (class given by the VAT rules and customer zone). A case without a tax keeps the VAT pending: the quotation cannot be sent or confirmed.
